name: Yamaha LB80 Chappy
engine: 49 or 72 cc air-cooled two-stroke single, Autolube oil injection, automatic
intro: Yamaha's fat-tire mini bike. A two-stroke with Autolube and a two-speed automatic.

B: It has oil injection, not premix. Keep the oil tank filled with two-stroke oil and check the pump line for cracks.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
